site.name: ASECAM
site.tagline: A Cameroonian community growing in Madagascar.
site.description: The Association of Cameroonian Students in Madagascar supports, connects and showcases its members in Antananarivo and across Madagascar.

home.heading: A presence, practical bearings and a community.
home.body: From Antananarivo, ASECAM brings together around 200 active members and builds practical bridges for Cameroonian students in Madagascar.
home.yearsBody: of mutual support, meetings and shared initiatives.

about.heading: A community moving forward together.
about.description: ASECAM is a close-knit association for young Cameroonians living in Madagascar.
about.history: For about five years, the association has grown through regular meetings, peer guidance and a simple ambition: helping every newcomer find support and practical bearings.
about.mission: Bringing together young Cameroonians living in Madagascar so they can settle, adapt, support one another, find guidance and become empowered through community and shared resources.
